project_type: Node.js CLI application with plugin architecture, REST API, watch mode, and Git integration. Desktop app (Electron) in /desktop-app/
build_system: npm with vitest for testing, eslint 9.x flat config, prettier, husky, lint-staged. Makefile for debian package builds.
test_framework: vitest with test/setup.js, 87 test files, 1211 tests passing. Coverage via v8 provider. Test command: npm test (or npm run test:coverage)
build_command: npm run build (no-op, no build step required). For debian: make build-deb
test_command: npm test (vitest run). npm run test:coverage for coverage report.
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm test to verify all 1211 tests pass. 2. Run npm run lint to check for warnings (currently has 30+ no-unused-vars warnings). 3. Run npm run format:check to verify formatting.
snapshot_or_generated_files: coverage/ directory generated by test:coverage. No snapshot tests. llm-context.json and token-analysis-report.json are CLI outputs, not versioned.
setup_instructions: 1. npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit. 2. Node.js 20.x or 22.x required (see .nvmrc with '22'). 3. For full functionality: tiktoken for exact token counting.
environment_constraints: Standard Node.js project. No Docker required. Network access needed for npm install.
contribution_requirements: Follow conventional commits (commitlint configured). Run lint and tests before committing. Husky pre-commit runs lint-staged.
key_patterns: ES Modules (type: module in package.json). Plugin architecture in lib/plugins/. Formatters in lib/formatters/. Analyzers in lib/analyzers/. API server in lib/api/. Wizards use Ink for terminal UI.
directory_structure: Root: CLI bin/, library lib/, tests test/, docs docs/, desktop app desktop-app/. lib/: analyzers/, parsers/, formatters/, utils/, api/, ui/, wizards/, plugins/, rag/, watch/, core/. docs/: content-en/, content-tr/ for bilingual docs. .github/: workflows/, ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, dependabot.yml, labeler.yml.

existing_ci_cd.ci_workflow: .github/workflows/ci.yml - comprehensive with matrix, coverage, codeql integration

missing_items.github_templates: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ exist but need review
